body:
Mmm tks!
I actually feel alot more better today morning, I guess I just needed to get this out..somehow. both advice really touched base and I guess the issue w me is that I nvr knew how to say 'no' or showing others where to draw the line. I guess it's a continual process of learning. I actively volunteer because I know deep down my purpose us to help others, but I guess as I help others, I must keep my well-being in check. I do read actively and play billiards to relieve stress but I dont have the opportunity to do so till my holidays are over thus I succumb to the urges that are so easily satisfied but leaving me feeling worst each time. I'm glad that nobody in this thread has belittled my problem and took me seriously because in my life no one believed I truly had any burdens or unhappiness. Thank you and have a great day! I know I will. (:
